title: At the Democratic Convention, a Historic Nomination

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的队伍。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝175周年，持续陪伴您理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: I'm standing in a sea of people coming out of this vast convention and people are holding signs, smiling.
sentences.zh: 我正站在人海中，人们从这个巨大的会场里走出来，手里拿着标语，面带微笑。

sentences.en: There's confetti everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是五彩纸屑。

sentences.en: There are balloons, white, red, and blue.
sentences.zh: 有白、红、蓝三色的气球。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of excitement.
sentences.zh: 现场气氛非常热烈。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: And this is The Daily from inside the Democratic National Convention Hall.
sentences.zh: 这里是民主党全国代表大会会场内播出的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Where Kamala Harris has just accepted her party's nomination.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯刚刚在这里接受了她所在党派的提名。

sentences.en: Becoming the first woman of color in U.S.
sentences.zh: 成为美国历史上第一位达成这一成就的

sentences.en: history to do so.
sentences.zh: 有色人种女性。

sentences.en: Today, the story this convention told about Harris.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲讲这次大会传递出的关于哈里斯的故事。

sentences.en: And whether that story could be enough to win.
sentences.zh: 以及这个故事是否足以赢得大选。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月23日，星期五。

sentences.en: The work and prayers of centuries have brought us to this day.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来的努力与祈愿将我们带到了今天。

sentences.en: What shall our legacy be?
sentences.zh: 我们的传承将会是什么？

sentences.en: What will our children say?
sentences.zh: 我们的子孙后代会怎么说？

sentences.en: Let me know in my heart what my days are through.
sentences.zh: 让我的内心明白我所度过的每一天是为了什么。

sentences.en: America, America, I gave my best to you.
sentences.zh: 美利坚，美利坚，我将我最好的一切献给了你。

sentences.en: On night one of the Democratic National Convention, the evening was really defined by this very emotional, quite bittersweet goodbye from President Biden.
sentences.zh: 在民主党全国代表大会的第一晚，当晚最深刻的定义来自于拜登总统充满情感且略带苦涩的告别。

sentences.en: And there's nothing we cannot do when we do it together.
sentences.zh: 只要我们齐心协力，就没有我们做不到的事。

sentences.en: It was the closing of one chapter so that another could begin.
sentences.zh: 这是一个章节的结束，好让另一个章节开启。

sentences.en: It was Kamala Harris's moment.
sentences.zh: 这是属于卡玛拉·哈里斯的高光时刻。

sentences.en: Day two kicked off with delegates gathering on the convention floor, casting their votes in a kind of symbolic way to make Harris the party's nominee.
sentences.zh: 第二天在代表们聚集在会场地板上的热闹氛围中拉开帷幕，他们以一种象征性的方式投票，正式确认哈里斯为党内提名人。

sentences.en: This giant festival of lights, people in cowboy hats, people with blinking bracelets, people with Christmas lights wrapped around their hats, heads, shoulders,
sentences.zh: 这是一场巨大的灯光节，人们戴着牛仔帽，戴着闪烁的手环，有人把圣诞彩灯缠在帽子上、头上、肩膀上，

sentences.en: people wearing donkey hats.
sentences.zh: 人们戴着驴子造型的帽子。

sentences.en: It's very, very, very celebratory in here.
sentences.zh: 这里充满了浓厚的庆祝氛围。

sentences.en: We need to see that we're moving on.
sentences.zh: 我们需要看到我们在向前迈进。

sentences.en: We're turning a chapter in America.
sentences.zh: 我们正在翻开美国的新篇章。

sentences.en: How do you feel right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Awesome, excitement, energized, ready to win this election.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，非常激动，充满活力，准备好赢得这次大选了。

sentences.en: I love it, I love it, I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了，太喜欢了，太喜欢了。

sentences.en: People are just excited, electrified, and they're just loving it and they're happy.
sentences.zh: 大家都很兴奋，备受鼓舞，他们乐在其中，非常开心。

sentences.en: This has been the most electrifying event I've ever attended in my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我这辈子参加过最令人振奋的活动。

sentences.en: It's my first convention.
sentences.zh: 这也是我第一次参加党代会。

sentences.en: But what a convention to come for, right?
sentences.zh: 但能来参加这样的大会真是太棒了，对吧？

sentences.en: To make history right now as we charge forward to November 5th to elect the first female black president.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻创造历史，我们正全力冲刺11月5日，选举出第一位女性黑人总统。

sentences.en: I'm excited.
sentences.zh: 我太兴奋了。

sentences.en: So with Harris now the nominee, a new campaign slogan appeared everywhere.
sentences.zh: 随着哈里斯正式成为提名人，一个新的竞选标语到处可见。

sentences.en: And that was a new way forward.
sentences.zh: 那就是“一条前进的新道路”。

sentences.en: But in a campaign that's just four weeks old, it was really an open question what a new way forward actually meant.
sentences.zh: 但在一个仅仅成立四周的竞选团队中，“前进的新道路”究竟意味着什么，其实还是一个开放的问题。

sentences.en: We're not going back.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不走回头路。

sentences.en: And then, over the course of the week, as speaker after speaker took the stage, we started to get an answer.
sentences.zh: 接着，在这一周里，随着演讲者们接连登台，我们开始得到了答案。

sentences.en: The story of forward would be told through the story of Kamala Harris herself.
sentences.zh: 关于“前进”的故事，将通过卡玛拉·哈里斯本人的人生故事来讲述。

sentences.en: And the question hanging over the week was really whether that story could appeal to a broad majority of Americans,
sentences.zh: 而贯穿整周的悬念其实是，这个故事能否吸引绝大多数美国人——

sentences.en: voters outside of the convention hall, who will ultimately decide the election.
sentences.zh: 也就是会场之外、最终将决定大选结果的选民们。

sentences.en: Asted, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 阿斯泰德，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Again, the second time in a week.
sentences.zh: 又见面了，这周的第二次。

sentences.en: And I am very excited for it.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: So, Asted, we had you on the show on Monday to answer a question for us that I think a lot of people have, which is, who is Kamala Harris?
sentences.zh: 那么，阿斯泰德，我们在周一请你上节目，是为了解答许多人心中都有的一个问题，那就是：卡玛拉·哈里斯究竟是谁？

sentences.en: And you ended that conversation by saying that the Democratic Party also recognizes this reality that for a lot of people she is still this sort of unknown quantity.
sentences.zh: 而你在对话结束时提到，民主党也意识到这样一个现实：对于很多人来说，她仍然是一个某种程度上未知的变数。

sentences.en: And that the party had a big task here at the convention this week, which was to find a way to finally tell her story.
sentences.zh: 并且党内在本周的大会上有一个重大的任务，那就是找到方法最终讲好她的故事。

sentences.en: Does seem like they've tried to do that.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们确实尝试去做了。

sentences.en: So, let's walk through the case that they're making for her and what you've seen here in your reporting for your show, The Run-Up.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们来梳理一下他们为她树立的公众形象，以及你在你的节目《冲刺》（The Run-Up）的报道中所看到的内容。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that the Democrats have definitely laid out a case for her as a candidate, but also a story for her as a person.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为民主党人确实为她作为候选人树立了形象，同时也为她作为一个人讲述了她的故事。

sentences.en: They have leaned into the different parts of her biography to really follow through on what I think is the best version of her campaign, which is a little bit for everybody.
sentences.zh: 他们深入挖掘了她生平经历的不同方面，来完美诠释我认为她最成功的竞选定位，那就是——满足各种人群的不同期待。

sentences.en: There is a story there about, you know, more moderate legislation, pieces of kind of progressive history.
sentences.zh: 其中既有关于相对温和的立法、也有关于某种进步主义历史片段的故事。

sentences.en: There's different parts of her bio that speak to, you know, black communities, immigrant communities, you know.
sentences.zh: 她生平的不同经历触及了黑人社区、移民社区等等。

sentences.en: Of course, the historic nature of her gender and the roles like that.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有她的性别以及类似角色所具有的历史意义。

sentences.en: And I really think it has followed through on kind of what I expected for this week, which is that she seems to function politically as a mirror of some sort,
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得这符合我对这周的预期，也就是她在政治上似乎发挥着某种镜子的作用，

sentences.en: where the party wants to position her as someone who basically, no matter what you're looking for in terms of a vessel to beat Donald Trump, you can find it in this candidate.
sentences.zh: 党内希望将她塑造成这样一个人：基本上无论你想寻找什么样能击败唐纳德·特朗普的载体，你都能在这个候选人身上找到。

sentences.en: So let's dig into that more.
sentences.zh: 那让我们更深入地探讨一下。

sentences.en: Where did the convention start that story?
sentences.zh: 大会是从哪里开始讲述这个故事的呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it really starts in her personal biography.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为它确实始于她的个人生平。

sentences.en: And I'm here tonight to tell you all about the Kamala Harris that I know.
sentences.zh: 我今晚站在这里，是为了向大家讲述我所了解的卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: They have told a story that she often tells about her being a first-generation American.
sentences.zh: 他们讲述了她经常提及的故事，即她是一名第一代美国人。

sentences.en: Her mother moved here from India at night.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲当年在夜色中从印度搬到这里。

sentences.en: Being a daughter of an immigrant mother who really raised two daughters in the Bay Area from kind of working-class roots.
sentences.zh: 作为一位移民母亲的女儿，她带着工人阶级的背景，在湾区独自抚养两个女儿长大。

sentences.en: And that's been a real thing that they've tried to own.
sentences.zh: 这是他们一直试图坦然面对并引以为傲的事情。

sentences.en: Kamala was not born into privilege.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉并非出身特权阶层。

sentences.en: She had to work for what she's got.
sentences.zh: 她今天拥有的一切都是靠自己努力争取来的。

sentences.en: When she was young, she worked at McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 她年轻时曾在麦当劳工作过。

sentences.en: They talk about her working at McDonald's in college.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到她在大学期间曾在麦当劳工作。

sentences.en: And she greeted every person with that thousand-watt smile and said, how can I help you?
sentences.zh: 她用那能照亮整个房间的灿烂微笑迎接每一个人，并问道：“有什么我可以帮您的吗？”

sentences.en: I think it's overall about trying to present this as someone who pulled himself up by bootstraps, represents an American dream.
sentences.zh: 我认为这总体上是想把她塑造成一个靠自己白手起家、代表着美国梦的人。

sentences.en: And I think for Democrats, it really returns them back to the place they want to be.
sentences.zh: 我想对民主党人来说，这确实让他们回到了他们想要坚守的阵地。

sentences.en: Democrats like thinking of themselves as a party who appeals to the diversity of America, both in racial ways and gender ways, but also in class ways.
sentences.zh: 民主党人喜欢把自己标榜为一个吸引美国多元化群体的政党，不仅在种族和性别方面，在阶层方面也是如此。

sentences.en: In Kamala Harris, we have a chance to elect a president who is for the middle class because she is from the middle class.
sentences.zh: 在卡玛拉·哈里斯身上，我们有机会选出一位为中产阶级发声的总统，因为她本身就来自中产阶级。

sentences.en: And I think they used other parts of her identity, specifically thinking about being the first Black woman to accept a major party's nomination.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们还利用了她身份的其他方面，特别是考虑到她是第一位接受主要政党提名的黑人女性。

sentences.en: We know folks are going to do everything they can to distort her truth.
sentences.zh: 我们知道有些人会不遗余力地歪曲她的真相。

sentences.en: And I think Michelle Obama's speech specifically spoke to the power and anxiety that sometimes that identity can bring.
sentences.zh: 我认为米歇尔·奥巴马的演讲具体谈到了这种身份有时会带来的力量与焦虑。

sentences.en: My husband and I sadly know a little something about this.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫不幸对这一点略知一二。

sentences.en: For years, Donald Trump did everything in his power to try to make people fear us.
sentences.zh: 多年来，唐纳德·特朗普竭尽全力试图让人们对我们产生恐惧。
zh_words: 唐纳德·特朗普竭尽全力

sentences.en: See, his limited, narrow view of the world made him feel threatened by the existence of two hard-working, highly-educated, successful people who happened.
sentences.zh: 看吧，他那狭隘、局限的世界观让他在两个勤奋、受过高等教育、取得成功的人存在时感到了威胁。

sentences.en: And I would also say that it was an implicit response to what Republicans and others have been trying to say, talking about Kamala Harris as a DEI hire,
sentences.zh: 我还要说的是，这也是对共和党人和其他人此前言论的一种无声回击，他们把卡玛拉·哈里斯称为“多元化招聘”的产物，

sentences.en: someone who was only in their position because of their identity.
sentences.zh: 认为她能坐到这个位置仅仅是因为她的身份。

sentences.en: But the way that Michelle Obama framed it was that those identities have power.
sentences.zh: 但米歇尔·奥巴马阐述的方式是，这些身份本身就蕴含着力量。

sentences.en: Tell him, who's going to tell him that the job he's currently seeking might just be one of those Black jobs?
sentences.zh: 告诉他，谁去告诉他，他现在正在追求的这份工作可能正好是那些“黑人的工作”之一呢？

sentences.en: Just because someone the first to be in a position does not mean that that is the only reason in the position.
sentences.zh: 一个人成为某个职位的首位，并不意味着这就是她坐上这个位置的唯一原因。

sentences.en: But it also doesn't make those identities meaningless.
sentences.zh: 但这也没有让这些身份变得毫无意义。

sentences.en: The fact that she is a Black woman should be seen as a strength, not as a weakness.
sentences.zh: 她是一位黑人女性这一事实应该被视为一种优势，而不是弱点。

sentences.en: Is there a risk to that, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，这样做有风险吗？

sentences.en: I mean, you know, by openly talking about race, is there a risk that goes too far and begins to alienate voters outside the convention out in the world who, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，通过公开谈论种族问题，会不会存在这样一种风险：走得太远，反而开始疏远那些在会场之外、在广阔世界中的选民，而那些选民——

sentences.en: they need to win in November?
sentences.zh: 是他们在11月必须要争取的对象？

sentences.en: Um, I mean, there's always a risk, but I don't really think so.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，风险总是存在的，但我其实并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Democrats have had increasing trouble with Black voters.
sentences.zh: 民主党人在争取黑人选民方面遇到的麻烦一直在增加。

sentences.en: There's been a downturn in Black vote share all the way dating back to 2012.
sentences.zh: 黑人选民的支持份额自2012年以来一直在下滑。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Biden's now suspended candidacy.
sentences.zh: 而随着拜登现在暂停参选，

sentences.en: That was one of the things driving his polling weaknesses was kind of tepid reception from Black voters.
sentences.zh: 导致他民调疲软的原因之一，正是黑人选民对他那种不温不火的反应。

sentences.en: You know, a pitch to them is something that is a upside of the Kamala Harris campaign.
sentences.zh: 你知道，向他们发出号召恰恰是卡玛拉·哈里斯竞选团队的一个优势所在。

sentences.en: And the hope that they could consolidate that community is where any Democratic nominee needs to be as a baseline.
sentences.zh: 而希望巩固这个群体的支持，正是任何民主党候选人必须达到的底线。

sentences.en: We both got our start as young lawyers, helping children who were abused and neglected.
sentences.zh: 我们两人都是从年轻律师做起，致力于帮助遭受虐待和忽视的儿童。

sentences.en: One thing I noticed that came up a lot during the speeches was her background as a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 我注意到在演讲中经常出现的一个背景是她曾担任检察官。

sentences.en: How did the party present that part of her biography?
sentences.zh: 党内是如何展现她生平中的这一部分的？

sentences.en: As a prosecutor, Kamala stood up for children who had been victims of sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 作为一名检察官，卡玛拉挺身而出，保护遭受性虐待的儿童。

sentences.en: She put rapists, child molesters, and murderers behind bars.
sentences.zh: 她将强奸犯、虐童犯和杀人犯送进了监狱。

sentences.en: They talk about it in the way that I think fuels what they want to say is the reason she can take on Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论这一点的方式，我认为强化了他们想要表达的理由——即她有能力与特朗普正面交锋。

sentences.en: That this is someone who has stood up to bullies before, who's not going to be intimidated easily.
sentences.zh: 这是一个曾经挺身对抗恶霸、绝不会轻易被吓倒的人。

sentences.en: And Kamala is as tough as it comes.
sentences.zh: 而且卡玛拉极其顽强。

sentences.en: Who's tough and who doesn't shirk away from a challenge.
sentences.zh: 她作风硬朗，从不畏惧挑战。

sentences.en: And she knows the best way to deal with a coward is to take him head on.
sentences.zh: 她知道对付懦夫最好的办法就是迎难而上。

sentences.en: Because we all know cowards are weak and Kamala Harris can smell weakness.
sentences.zh: 因为我们都知道懦夫是虚弱的，而卡玛拉·哈里斯能嗅出虚弱的气息。

sentences.en: But I think all of that adds up to say, you can trust this person to go up against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我认为所有这些都说明了一点：你可以信任这个人去对抗唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: You can trust this person to go up against the Republican Party because she's not someone who is scared.
sentences.zh: 你可以信任这个人去对抗共和党，因为她不是一个胆小怕事的人。

sentences.en: She never runs from a fight.
sentences.zh: 她从不逃避战斗。

sentences.en: A woman, a fierce woman, for the people.
sentences.zh: 一个坚定坚强、为人民服务的女性。

sentences.en: But then of course we heard about another side of Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们也听到了卡玛拉·哈里斯的另一面。

sentences.en: A more personal side.
sentences.zh: 一个更加个人化的一面。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think this is the part of Kamala Harris where I think was kind of most missing in the presidential run.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是卡玛拉·哈里斯在总统竞选中似乎最缺失的一部分。

sentences.en: Frankly, it's the part that she keeps most private.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这也是她保护得最严密的部分。

sentences.en: She is a warm family member and friend.
sentences.zh: 她是一个温暖的家庭成员和朋友。

sentences.en: Hello to my big, beautiful, blended family up there.
sentences.zh: 向我那庞大、美好、重组的大家庭问好。

sentences.en: And I think what the speech from her husband did was really show and lay that out.
sentences.zh: 我认为她丈夫的演讲真正展现并表达了这一点。

sentences.en: I got married, became a dad to Colin Ella.
sentences.zh: 我结婚了，成了科尔和埃拉的爸爸。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I went through a divorce.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我经历了一段失败的婚姻。

sentences.en: But eventually started worrying about how I would make it all work.
sentences.zh: 但最终开始担心我该如何让这一切顺利运转。

sentences.en: And that's when something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，意想不到的事情发生了。

sentences.en: I ended up with Kamala Harris' phone number.
sentences.zh: 我得到了卡玛拉·哈里斯的电话号码。

sentences.en: He talks about the kind of awkwardness of their first interaction.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了他们第一次互动时的那种尴尬。

sentences.en: I got Kamala's voicemail and I just started rambling.
sentences.zh: 我转到了卡玛拉的语音信箱，然后就开始语无伦次地唠叨起来。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Doug.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是道格。

sentences.en: And I think you have a real kind of sense of their genuine connection to one another.
sentences.zh: 我想你能真切地感受到他们之间那种真挚的情感连结。

sentences.en: By the way, Kamala saved that voicemail.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，卡玛拉把那个语音留言保存了下来。

sentences.en: Like, yes, this is someone who is tough, who is taking on corporations and cartels and all of that stuff by day.
sentences.zh: 比如，没错，这是一个作风硬朗的人，她白天要应对各大企业、贩毒集团以及各种各样的事。

sentences.en: But it's someone who also makes a point to cook Sunday dinner for family every week.
sentences.zh: 但她也是一个坚持每周都为家人做周日晚餐的人。

sentences.en: And she makes a mean brisket for Passover.
sentences.zh: 而且她做逾越节的烤胸肉可是一绝。

sentences.en: And makes sure to really go close to his kids and is very close with her family.
sentences.zh: 她确保自己和孩子们非常亲近，跟家人的关系也十分密切。

sentences.en: That's Kamala.
sentences.zh: 这就是卡玛拉。

sentences.en: She's always been there for our children.
sentences.zh: 她一直陪伴着我们的孩子们。

sentences.en: And I know she'll always be there for yours, too.
sentences.zh: 我也知道，她也一定会陪伴着你们的孩子。

sentences.en: You know, going back to the last time the Democratic Party nominated a woman, Hillary Clinton, she had presented herself in a very different way, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，回想起民主党上次提名女性候选人希拉里·克林顿的时候，她展现自己的方式非常不同，对吧？

sentences.en: She was like, kind of ran away from that stuff.
sentences.zh: 她当时就好像、有点刻意避开那些东西。

sentences.en: She was saying, you know, I don't bake cookies.
sentences.zh: 她会说，你知道的，我不烤饼干。

sentences.en: That's not what I do.
sentences.zh: 那不是我做的事。

sentences.en: I'm kind of out there with the men fighting.
sentences.zh: 我是那种跟男人们一起冲在前面战斗的人。

sentences.en: And this convention and this candidate, Harris, is very different.
sentences.zh: 而这次大会和这位候选人哈里斯则大不相同。

sentences.en: She's a newer generation.
sentences.zh: 她代表着新的一代。

sentences.en: And she can do her career and bake cookies.
sentences.zh: 她既能搞定自己的事业，也能烤饼干。

sentences.en: Those things are not in conflict.
sentences.zh: 这两者并不冲突。

sentences.en: This is like a different type of woman leader.
sentences.zh: 这是一种不同类型的女性领导者。

sentences.en: You know, this week we talked to Senator Elizabeth Warren on the run-up.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这周我们在筹备期间采访了参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: And one of the things that she mentioned was she feels that there's been a big change from 2016, even 2020, to now.
sentences.zh: 她提到的一点是，她觉得从2016年、甚至2020年到现在，发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: Not just the amount of women in public office.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是公职女性的数量。

sentences.en: But she said they don't have to choose between sides of themselves.
sentences.zh: 但她说，她们不必在自身的各面之间做出选择。

sentences.en: And I think that's what diversity means, right?
sentences.zh: 我想这就是多元化的含义，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, of course, Kamala Harris can be a tough politician and also bake cookies.
sentences.zh: 比如，卡玛拉·哈里斯当然可以成为一名强硬的政治家，同时也烤饼干。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton did that, too.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿也这么做过。

sentences.en: It was just that she was told that that was not the way that she had to present herself.
sentences.zh: 只不过当时有人告诉她，那并不是她必须展现自己的方式。

sentences.en: What Kamala Harris is, is benefiting from, is there's a greater space and ability to choose multiple things at once.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯所享受、所受益的是，现在有了更大的空间和能力去同时选择多重身份。

sentences.en: And so, particularly if others are going to talk more directly about gender or race or other things, that kind of frees her from having the burden of doing that herself.
sentences.zh: 因此，特别是如果其他人要更直接地谈论性别、种族或其他问题时，这其实卸下了她自己去承担这些的重担。

sentences.en: And, in fact, Hillary Clinton herself did speak, of course, on day one.
sentences.zh: 事实上，希拉里·克林顿本人当然也在第一天发表了讲话。

sentences.en: She talked about that glass ceiling and the history that has led to now, including her own experience in 2016.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了那块玻璃天花板以及通往现在这段历史，包括她自己在2016年的经历。

sentences.en: Yeah, I thought the Hillary Clinton speech was really powerful.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得希拉里·克林顿的演讲非常有力量。

sentences.en: I think a lot of the speakers put this moment in kind of historical context, both politically and personally.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多发言者都把这个时刻置于一种历史语境中，无论是从政治上还是个人角度。

sentences.en: You know, my mother Dorothy was born right here in Chicago before women had the right to vote.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的母亲多萝西就出生在芝加哥，当时女性还没有投票权。

sentences.en: That changed 104 years ago yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天正好是那项权利改变104周年。

sentences.en: And since that day, every generation has carried the torch forward.
sentences.zh: 从那一天起，每一代人都将火炬传递下去。

sentences.en: In 1972, a fearless black congresswoman named Shirley Chisholm, president.
sentences.zh: 1972年，一位无畏的黑人女国会议员雪莉·奇瑟姆竞选总统。

sentences.en: In 1984, I brought my daughter to see Geraldine Ferraro, the first woman nominated for vice president.
sentences.zh: 1984年，我带着女儿去看杰拉尔丁·费拉罗，她是第一位被提名为副总统的女性。

sentences.en: And then there was 2016, when it was the honor of my life to accept our party's nomination for president.
sentences.zh: 然后到了2016年，我有幸接受我们党内的总统候选人提名，这是我一生的荣幸。

sentences.en: The last time I was here in my hometown was to memorialize my mother.
sentences.zh: 我上次来到我的家乡是为了纪念我的母亲。

sentences.en: The woman who showed me the power of my own voice.
sentences.zh: 这位女性让我看到了我自己声音的力量。

sentences.en: My mother volunteered at the local school.
sentences.zh: 我的母亲曾在当地学校做志愿者。

sentences.en: I'm the proud granddaughter of a housekeeper, Sarah Daisy, who raised her three children in a one-bedroom apartment.
sentences.zh: 我是莎拉·黛西这位管家自豪的孙女，她在一间一居室的公寓里养大了三个孩子。

sentences.en: It was her dream to work in government, to help people.
sentences.zh: 她的梦想就是在政府工作，去帮助人们。

sentences.en: My grandmother, the woman who helped raise me as a child.
sentences.zh: 我的祖母，那个在我小时候帮着抚养我长大的女人。

sentences.en: A little old white lady born in a tiny town called Piru, Kansas.
sentences.zh: 一个出生在堪萨斯州皮鲁小镇的白人老太太。

sentences.en: I want to talk now about somebody who's not with us tonight.
sentences.zh: 我现在想谈谈今晚不在我们身边的一个人。

sentences.en: Tessie Prevost Williams was born in New Orleans, not long after the Supreme Court ruled that segregated public schools were unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 泰西·普雷沃斯特·威廉姆斯出生在新奥尔良，就在最高法院裁定公立学校实行种族隔离违宪后不久。
zh_words: 泰西·普雷沃斯特·威廉姆斯

sentences.en: That was in 1954, same year I was born.
sentences.zh: 那是1954年，跟我出生的年份一样。

sentences.en: Parents pulled their kids out of the school.
sentences.zh: 父母们把他们的孩子从学校里接走了。

sentences.en: There was a way that I think the candidacy and the person was placed in a long legacy, both about gender identity and racial identity,
sentences.zh: 我觉得她的候选人身份和个人经历被赋予了一种长期的传承意义，既关乎性别认同也关乎种族认同，

sentences.en: that kind of teed up this Thursday as a culminating moment, both politically and I think in a broader historical context.
sentences.zh: 这为这个星期四铺垫成了一个高潮时刻，无论是在政治上还是在更广阔的历史背景下。

sentences.en: Together, we put a lot of cracks in the highest, hardest glass ceiling.
sentences.zh: 我们齐心协力，在最高、最硬的玻璃天花板上砸出了许多裂痕。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: On the other side of that glass ceiling is Kamala Harris raising her hand and taking the oath of office as our 47th president of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在这块玻璃天花板的另一边，卡玛拉·哈里斯正举起手，宣誓就职成为我们美国第47任总统。

sentences.en: Mother could see us.
sentences.zh: 如果母亲们能看到我们。

sentences.en: They would say, keep going.
sentences.zh: 她们会说，继续前进。

sentences.en: Shirley and Jerry would say.
sentences.zh: 雪莉和杰瑞也会这么说。

sentences.en: I think you can do a lot to set up a candidate to be in a good position.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你可以为候选人做好很多准备，让她处于有利地位。

sentences.en: Like, all of this stuff adds up to some part of the puzzle, but the biggest piece is the candidate themselves.
sentences.zh: 比如，所有这些元素拼凑成了拼图的一部分，但最大的一块拼图是候选人自己。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, they have to close the deal.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，他们必须完成最后关头的工作。

sentences.en: And I think this moment is her chance to tell her own story in a way that sometimes she has not decided to.
sentences.zh: 而我认为这个时刻是她讲述自己故事的机会，用一种她有时并未选择采用的方式。

sentences.en: And that's still what this whole convention, success and failure will ride on.
sentences.zh: 这依然是这场代表大会成败的关键所在。

sentences.en: So, we're going to watch tonight.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们今晚要拭目以待。

sentences.en: We're going to watch with our colleague Reid Epstein.
sentences.zh: 我们将和我们的同事里德·爱泼斯坦一起观看。

sentences.en: And you are going to have a great episode of The Run-Up on Friday.
sentences.zh: 而你们周五将会听到一期精彩的《The Run-Up》节目。

sentences.en: We will all be tuning in.
sentences.zh: 我们都会收听的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I appreciate you doing this, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你做这些，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Really, thanks a lot, Estet.
sentences.zh: 真的，非常感谢，埃斯特。

sentences.en: Ahead of Harris' speech, we went out to talk with delegates to find out what they were hearing in this story that the convention was telling about Harris.
sentences.zh: 在哈里斯发表演讲之前，我们去采访了代表们，想了解他们从大会讲述的关于哈里斯的故事中听到了什么。

sentences.en: Are you a delegate?
sentences.zh: 你是代表吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Sorry, we caught you mid-French fry eating.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我们打扰你吃薯条了。

sentences.en: What's your feeling about Kamala and kind of what her story has been?
sentences.zh: 你对卡玛拉以及她的经历有什么感受？

sentences.en: Are you getting to know her this week?
sentences.zh: 这周你更了解她了吗？

sentences.en: Are there things you've learned about her this week?
sentences.zh: 这周你有没有了解到关于她的新事物？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm learning more and more as we go along.
sentences.zh: 对，随着时间推移我了解得越来越多了。

sentences.en: The more and more I learn about her, the more I'm impressed with her.
sentences.zh: 我对她的了解越多，她给我的印象就越深刻。

sentences.en: I mean, she worked at McDonald's when she was going to college to try to pay her way through.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她上大学时为了自食其力曾在麦当劳工作过。

sentences.en: Her very small beginnings, not a trust fund baby type of thing.
sentences.zh: 她出身非常卑微，可不是那种含着金汤匙出生的人。

sentences.en: I relate to that.
sentences.zh: 我对此深有共鸣。

sentences.en: Like, I was on food stamps this year, you know, so it's like if she can do it with that background, it gives everybody hope.
sentences.zh: 比如，我今年还领过食品券呢，所以这就好比如果她有着这样的背景也能成功，这就给了所有人希望。

sentences.en: Hillary was my girl.
sentences.zh: 希拉里曾是我的女神。

sentences.en: When Hillary ran, I championed her as well, but I didn't feel this way as I feel about Harris.
sentences.zh: 当希拉里参选时，我也支持她，但我没有对哈里斯的那种感觉。

sentences.en: I'm like, do I want to run for office?
sentences.zh: 我会想，我是不是也想竞选公职？

sentences.en: If she can do it, she looks just like me, right?
sentences.zh: 如果她能做到，而且她长得跟我一模一样，对吧？

sentences.en: She represents, she worked at McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 她代表着大众，她在麦当劳工作过。

sentences.en: She paid for, it's relatable.
sentences.zh: 她自己付学费，这让人很有共鸣。

sentences.en: And that's what everybody needs, so.
sentences.zh: 这就是每个人所需要的，所以。

sentences.en: We're going to break that glass ceiling and I'm getting teary and teary in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我们要打破那块玻璃天花板，我的眼泪都快夺眶而出了。

sentences.en: And it just means so much, you know, to be inclusive.
sentences.zh: 这意味着太多了，你知道的，包容是多么重要。

sentences.en: What does it mean to you that Kamala Harris is a woman?
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯是一位女性，这对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: What does it mean to you that she's a black woman?
sentences.zh: 她是一位黑人女性，这对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: Oh, to have a black woman become the president of the United States and for her to have turned the world upside down in 30 days,
sentences.zh: 哦，能让一位黑人女性成为美国总统，而且她在30天内就让世界天翻地覆，

sentences.en: to know that I'm in the midst of this miraculous history is phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 知道自己正身处这奇迹般的历史之中，这太了不起了。

sentences.en: One delegate who really stood out to us was Beverly Hatcher, a 76-year-old black woman from Texas.
sentences.zh: 有一个代表给我们留下了深刻的印象，她叫贝弗利·哈彻，是一位来自德克萨斯州的76岁黑人女性。

sentences.en: I was raised by a wonderful Baptist mama.
sentences.zh: 我是被一位出色的浸信会妈妈抚养长大的。

sentences.en: I just lost her.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚失去她。

sentences.en: But I am who I am because of my mother.
sentences.zh: 但我之所以成为今天的我，全是因为我的母亲。

sentences.en: We were always pushed to do whatever we wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我们总是被鼓励去做任何我们想做的事。

sentences.en: Hey, I'll never forget, I wanted to be a majorette.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我永远不会忘记，我曾经想当一名仪仗队队长。

sentences.en: I taught myself because we had no money for, what is it called, lessons.
sentences.zh: 我自己学，因为我们没有钱支付什么培训班的费用。

sentences.en: And a majorette is like the baton twirler, right?
sentences.zh: 仪仗队队长就像是挥舞指挥棒的人，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And when I did finally try out in my 11th grade, I won right off.
sentences.zh: 当我终于在11年级参加选拔时，我一下子就胜出了。

sentences.en: And my classmates, who were predominantly white, as years have gone by, have told me at class reunions and stuff, barely.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，我的那些主要是白人的同班同学在同学聚会之类的场合上对我说，简直难以置信。

sentences.en: The sleepy town of Wellington woke up, oh my God, we got a black girl getting ready to be the head majorette.
sentences.zh: 惠灵顿那个安静的小镇沸腾了，我的天哪，我们这儿居然要出一个黑人女孩当首席仪仗队队长了。

sentences.en: But, it happened because I had the drive and the will.
sentences.zh: 但是，这一切之所以发生，是因为我有冲劲和意志。

sentences.en: My mother and my family stood behind me and didn't miss a parade or a football game or a basketball game.
sentences.zh: 我的母亲和我的家人一直支持我，没有错过任何一场游行、一场足球比赛或一场篮球比赛。

sentences.en: And you see that in Harris?
sentences.zh: 你在哈里斯身上也看到了这一点吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Beverly, what would your mom say if she saw this?
sentences.zh: 贝弗利，如果你的妈妈看到这一幕，她会说什么？

sentences.en: My sisters have been telling me every day how proud my mom is.
sentences.zh: 我的姐妹们每天都在告诉我妈妈有多骄傲。

sentences.en: And I'm just happy to, I'm happy to make her happy.
sentences.zh: 我只是很高兴能、很高兴能让她开心。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We, we women who have had mothers like Kamala, like Michelle, I remember Hillary's mother.
sentences.zh: 我们，我们这些拥有像卡玛拉、像米歇尔这样的母亲的女性，我还记得希拉里的母亲。

sentences.en: We, women, value their strength and their wisdom.
sentences.zh: 我们女性珍视她们的力量与智慧。

sentences.en: And we're just glad that they gave us a legacy to pass it on.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴她们留下了宝贵的精神财富供我们传承。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏《Connections》的作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图难倒你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉症的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才你听到声音的这些人一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始游玩今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: Reed, hello.
sentences.zh: 里德，你好。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: So, okay.
sentences.zh: 那么，好的。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris just wrapped up her acceptance speech.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯刚刚结束了她的提名接受演讲。

sentences.en: Before we talk about what she said in the case she presented, tell us how her campaign was thinking about the stakes of this moment.
sentences.zh: 在我们讨论她说过的内容以及她所阐述的立场之前，先跟我们讲讲她的竞选团队是如何看待这一时刻的重要性的。

sentences.en: You know, Sabrina, this evening was one of two opportunities, along with a debate next month, for her to speak to tens of millions of people at once.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，萨布丽娜，今晚是她同时对数千万观众讲话的两次机会之一，另一次是下个月的辩论。

sentences.en: And so, for that, the stakes were really high.
sentences.zh: 因此，对她而言，这次的利害关系非常重大。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: her goal was to present herself as a serious person and a serious candidate who was not the candidate who flamed out in 2019 or the unsteady vice president from the beginning of her term.
sentences.zh: 她的目标是将自己塑造为一个严肃的人和严肃的候选人，而不是那个在2019年草草收场或在任期初显得不稳定的副总统。

sentences.en: She had to show that she has the gravitas to be the commander-in-chief, the political aptitude to reach out to the middle,
sentences.zh: 她必须展现出她具备担任三军统帅的庄重气质，拥有争取中间派的政治才能，

sentences.en: and also to progressives in her party all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 同时也兼顾党内的进步派，所有这一切要同时做到。

sentences.en: So, a very tall order.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个非常艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: Tell us how she went about doing that.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲她是怎样做到的。

sentences.en: Well, she started talking around 9.30 Chicago time to a packed united center with 14,000 or 15,000 people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她在芝加哥时间9点半左右开始发言，当时座无虚席的联合中心球馆挤满了1.4万到1.5万人。

sentences.en: Many, many wearing all white.
sentences.zh: 许多、许多人身穿全白服装。

sentences.en: The color of the suffragettes.
sentences.zh: 那是女性选举权论者的颜色。

sentences.en: A color that makes a statement just by wearing it.
sentences.zh: 一种仅仅穿上它就能表明立场的颜色。

sentences.en: And when Harris took to stage, they erupted in a cheer that forced her for a couple minutes to wait before she could start talking.
sentences.zh: 当哈里斯走上舞台时，全场爆发出一阵欢呼声，这迫使她等了好几分钟才能开始讲话。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: Okay, let's get to business.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们言归正传。

sentences.en: Let's get to business.
sentences.zh: 言归正传吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what did she finally say once she started talking?
sentences.zh: 她开始说话后，最后到底说了什么？

sentences.en: You know, she told the story of her life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她讲了她的人生经历。

sentences.en: The path that led me here in recent weeks was no doubt unexpected.
sentences.zh: 在最近几周引领我来到这里的道路无疑是意料之外的。

sentences.en: But I'm no stranger to unlikely journeys.
sentences.zh: 但我对不太可能的旅程并不陌生。

sentences.en: So, my mother, our mother, Shamala Harris, had one of her own.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的母亲，我们的母亲，沙玛拉·哈里斯，她也有着自己的一段经历。

sentences.en: And I miss her every day, and especially right now.
sentences.zh: 我每天都思念她，尤其是现在。

sentences.en: She talked about the influence of her mother, who raised her and her sister.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了她母亲的影响，正是她母亲抚养了她和她的妹妹。

sentences.en: And she also taught us, and never do anything half-assed.
sentences.zh: 她还教导我们，做事绝不能半途而废。

sentences.en: And that is a direct quote.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是原话。

sentences.en: She spoke about her family's humble beginnings in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了她家族在奥克兰的卑微起步。

sentences.en: Before she could finally afford to buy a home, she rented a small apartment in the East Bay.
sentences.zh: 在她终于买得起房子之前，她在东湾租了一间小公寓。

sentences.en: Then she started talking about her career as a prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始谈论她作为检察官的职业生涯。

sentences.en: In the courtroom, I stood proudly before a judge, and I said five words.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，我骄傲地站在法官面前，我说了五个字。

sentences.en: She brought back one of the lines that she used in her 2020 campaign about how when she stood up in a courtroom, she began with the same words.
sentences.zh: 她重提了她在2020年竞选时用过的一句话，关于当她站在法庭上时，她是用同样的字眼开始的。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris for the people.
sentences.zh: 卡马拉·哈里斯，为了人民。

sentences.en: And she said she would bring that same philosophy to the White House, that she was not working for specific individuals, but for the people at large.
sentences.zh: 她说她将把同样的理念带到白宫，她不是为特定的个人工作，而是为了广大人民。

sentences.en: And so, on behalf of the people.
sentences.zh: 因此，代表人民。

sentences.en: Eventually, she did a big wind-up to formally accepting the nomination.
sentences.zh: 最终，她进行了盛大的铺垫，正式接受了提名。

sentences.en: On behalf of every American, regardless of party, race, gender, or the language your grandmother speaks.
sentences.zh: 代表每一位美国人，不论党派、种族、性别，或者你祖母说的是什么语言。

sentences.en: And listed the people on whose behalf she did so.
sentences.zh: 并列举了她所代表的人们。

sentences.en: On behalf of everyone whose story could only be written in the greatest nation on earth.
sentences.zh: 为了每一个其故事只能在地球上最伟大的国家书写的群体。

sentences.en: It was really a kind of a feat of speech writing to build up to this big emotional moment.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一种演讲写作的技巧，为这个充满情感的盛大时刻做铺垫。

sentences.en: I accept your nomination.
sentences.zh: 我接受您的提名。

sentences.en: What did you make of that, how she was doing it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看她当时的表现，她是怎么做的？

sentences.en: You know, it was building up this speech to be a serious political document and present her as a serious figure in this moment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是在将这场演讲打造成一份严肃的政治文件，并在此时将她塑造成一个严肃的人物。

sentences.en: And so, she still has to prove to people that she is capable of being the commander-in-chief and running the country.
sentences.zh: 因此，她仍然向人们证明她有能力成为三军统帅并治理这个国家。

sentences.en: And how does she try to prove that she's capable of that, of being a commander-in-chief?
sentences.zh: 她是如何试图证明自己有能力胜任三军统帅这一职位的？

sentences.en: You know, what she did was try to draw the distinction between herself and Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她所做的是试图划清她与唐纳德·特朗普的界限。

sentences.en: In many ways, Donald Trump is an unserious man.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，唐纳德·特朗普是一个不够严肃的人。

sentences.en: But the consequences, but the consequences of putting Donald Trump back in the White House are extremely serious.
sentences.zh: 但把唐纳德·特朗普重新送回白宫的后果，后果是极其严重的。

sentences.en: And she warns that Trump would not have guardrails on him if he were elected to a second term.
sentences.zh: 她警告说，如果特朗普当选第二个任期，他将不再受到约束。

sentences.en: Just imagine Donald Trump with no guardrails and how he would use the immense powers of the presidency of the United States.
sentences.zh: 试想一下没有任何约束的唐纳德·特朗普，以及他将如何动用美国总统的巨大权力。

sentences.en: Not to improve your life, not to strengthen our national security, but to serve the only client he has ever had.
sentences.zh: 不是为了改善你的生活，不是为了加强我们的国家安全，而是为了服务他唯一效忠过的客户。

sentences.en: Himself!
sentences.zh: 他自己！

sentences.en: The speech was very clear-eyed about the stakes of the election.
sentences.zh: 这场演讲对选举的利害关系看得很透彻。

sentences.en: There was a whole section in the middle of the speech where she ticked through, you know, one by one,
sentences.zh: 演讲中间有一整段，她逐一盘点了，你知道的，

sentences.en: a whole series of warnings about things that Trump would do to the country if he were back in the White House.
sentences.zh: 一系列关于如果特朗普重返白宫将会对这个国家做的事情的警告。

sentences.en: Get this, he plans to create a national anti-abortion coordinator and force states to report on women's miscarriages and abortions.
sentences.zh: 你听着，他计划设立一个全国反堕胎协调员，并强迫各州报告女性的流产和堕胎情况。

sentences.en: Simply put, they are out of their minds.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们疯了。

sentences.en: What else stuck out to you?
sentences.zh: 还有什么让你印象深刻？

sentences.en: You know, it was remarkable, the section of the speech where she talked about Gaza.
sentences.zh: 你知道，演讲中她谈到加沙的那一部分非常引人注目。

sentences.en: President Biden and I are working around the clock because now is the time to get a hostage deal and a ceasefire deal done.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统和我正在夜以继日地工作，因为现在是达成被扣押人员协议和停火协议的时候了。

sentences.en: She did not veer too far to the left.
sentences.zh: 她并没有过分向左倾斜。

sentences.en: I will always stand up for Israel's right to defend itself.
sentences.zh: 我将永远捍卫以色列自卫的权利。

sentences.en: She managed to say things that would be appealing to both sides.
sentences.zh: 她设法说出了能够吸引双方的话。

sentences.en: President Biden and I are working to end this war.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统和我正致力于结束这场战争。

sentences.en: Such that Israel is secure, the hostages are released, the suffering in Gaza ends, and the Palestinian people can realize their right to dignity, security, freedom.
sentences.zh: 确保以色列的安全，释放人质，结束加沙的苦难，让巴勒斯坦人民实现他们对尊严、安全和自由的权利。

sentences.en: It was a remarkable moment to hear the arena erupt at the end of that section.
sentences.zh: 听到这一段结束时全场爆发的欢呼，那是一个令人难忘的时刻。

sentences.en: To hear her support for both the Israelis and the Palestinians reveal that kind of enthusiasm, you know,
sentences.zh: 听到她对以色列人和巴勒斯坦人的支持激发出那种热情，你知道的，

sentences.en: after the party has been really ripped apart for months about how to handle the situation.
sentences.zh: 此前该党已经因为如何处理这一局势而分裂了几个月之久。

sentences.en: Fellow Americans, I love our country with all my heart.
sentences.zh: 美国同胞们，我全心全意地热爱我们的国家。

sentences.en: You know, she ended the speech with a pay-on to patriotism.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她以对爱国主义的赞美结束了演讲。

sentences.en: We are the heirs to the greatest democracy in the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 我们是世界历史上最伟大民主制度的继承者。

sentences.en: She dove headlong into the American exceptionalism argument that is native to Republicans and to older generations of politicians like Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 她一头扎进了美国例外论的论点，这原本是共和党人和乔·拜登等老一辈政客的专属。

sentences.en: It is now our turn to do what generations before us have done, guided by optimism and faith to fight for this country we love.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到我们去做前几代人做过的事了，在乐观和信念的指引下，为我们深爱的这个国家而战。

sentences.en: But it's not something you always hear from younger Democrats who are a little less comfortable with some of the flag waving.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是你总能从年轻民主党人那里听到的，他们对一些挥舞国旗的做法感到有点不太习惯。

sentences.en: Let's vote for the next great chapter in the most extraordinary story ever told of America.
sentences.zh: 让我们投票开启美国有史以来最非凡故事的下一个伟大篇章。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: She seemed to really be taking aim at this criticism of her, which is that she's, you know, this radical California liberal and she can't be trusted with the keys to the country.
sentences.zh: 她似乎确实在回击针对她的批评，也就是，你知道的，她是个激进的加州自由派，不能把国家大权交托给她信任。

sentences.en: I mean, that was one of the tasks that she had tonight was to make the argument, particularly the voters in the middle,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她今晚的任务之一就是阐明观点，特别是针对中间选民，

sentences.en: the suburban voters that used to vote for Republicans but have been repelled by Trump and driven to Democrats in the last several years,
sentences.zh: 那些曾经投票给共和党，但在过去几年里被特朗普排挤并转向民主党的郊区选民，

sentences.en: that they can vote for her without worrying that she's some kind of sort of Bernie Sanders acolyte.
sentences.zh: 让他们可以投票给她，而不必担心她是什么伯尼·桑德斯的追随者。

sentences.en: You know, and some of that is based on the way she ran her last presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一部分原因基于她上一次总统竞选的方式。

sentences.en: Some of it, frankly, is because she's a black woman from California and that the voters who will determine this election are, you know,
sentences.zh: 坦白说，部分原因是因为她是一个来自加州的黑人女性，而决定这次选举的选民，你知道的，

sentences.en: voters in less diverse states for the most part.
sentences.zh: 大多是来自多元化程度较低的州的选民。

sentences.en: So, Reid, stepping back here, you know, it feels worth remembering just where we were at the end of the Republican National Convention that was, you know, just over a month ago.
sentences.zh: 所以，里德，退一步讲，你知道的，我们有必要回想一下就在一个多月前的共和党全国代表大会结束时我们的处境。

sentences.en: Things couldn't have felt more different.
sentences.zh: 情况可以说是天差地别。

sentences.en: The GOP was on top of the world while the Democrats were in disarray over Biden's refusal to leave the race.
sentences.zh: 共和党人正处于巅峰，而民主党人则因拜登拒绝退选而陷入混乱。

sentences.en: And now here we are.
sentences.zh: 现在我们来到了这里。

sentences.en: And it feels like things couldn't be better for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 感觉民主党的情况再好不过了。

sentences.en: At least that's the feeling I'm having coming out of this convention.
sentences.zh: 至少这是我走出这次大会时的感受。

sentences.en: I mean, the whole race has turned upside down from where it was when we left Milwaukee.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，整个竞选格局与我们离开密尔沃基时相比已经彻底颠倒了。

sentences.en: And Democrats are upbeat.
sentences.zh: 民主党人情绪高涨。

sentences.en: They are confident.
sentences.zh: 他们信心满满。

sentences.en: It is a party that is remarkably united behind their candidate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个空前团结在他们候选人身后的政党。

sentences.en: But you have to remember, this election will be very close.
sentences.zh: 但你必须记住，这次选举将非常接近。

sentences.en: It is indeed a game of inches in the key battleground states.
sentences.zh: 在关键摇摆州，这确实是毫厘之争。

sentences.en: And what she was trying to do was to present herself as someone who can be trusted as commander-in-chief to win over the tiny slices of the electorate that will determine the winner in places like Wisconsin and Michigan and Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 她试图做的是把自己塑造成一个可以被信任的三军统帅，以争取威斯康星州、密歇根州、宾夕法尼亚州等地决定胜负的一小部分选民，

sentences.en: Georgia and Arizona.
sentences.zh: 佐治亚州和亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: And those are the states that will determine the election.
sentences.zh: 这些才是决定选举结果的州。

sentences.en: And they have made a calculated decision that those voters needed to see her as a commander-in-chief, something they had not seen from her before.
sentences.zh: 他们经过深思熟虑做出了决定，这些选民需要将她视为三军统帅，这是他们以前在她身上没有看到过的。

sentences.en: And we will see in the coming days and weeks whether she's accomplished that in a way that brings enough of those people on board for her to win a term as president.
sentences.zh: 我们将在未来几天和几周内看到她是否已经做到了这一点，从而争取到足够多的人支持她赢得总统任期。

sentences.en: Reid, thank you.
sentences.zh: 里德，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Supreme Court allowed Arizona Republicans, for now, to impose tougher voting requirements,
sentences.zh: 周四，最高法院暂时允许亚利桑那州共和党人实施更严格的投票要求，

sentences.en: including a new rule that people registering to vote there before the coming election must show proof of citizenship.
sentences.zh: 包括一项新规定，即在该州即将到来的选举前登记投票的人必须出示国籍证明。

sentences.en: As a result, Arizonans newly registering to vote for this year's presidential election must provide copies of one of several documents, such as a birth certificate or a passport,
sentences.zh: 因此，今年总统大选新登记投票的亚利桑那州人必须提供几种文件之一的副本，例如出生证明或护照，

sentences.en: in order to prove that they are U.S.
sentences.zh: 以证明他们是美国

sentences.en: citizens.
sentences.zh: 公民。

sentences.en: Democrats have denounced the new rule as an attempt to prevent legal immigrants from voting.
sentences.zh: 民主党人谴责这项新规定是阻止合法移民投票的企图。

sentences.en: And U.S.
sentences.zh: 此外，美国

sentences.en: health officials have approved the latest slate of annual COVID vaccines, clearing the way for Americans six months and older to receive updated shots in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 卫生官员已经批准了最新一批年度新冠疫苗，为美国人六个月及以上在未来几天接种更新版疫苗扫清了道路。

sentences.en: The approvals come amid a prolonged surge of COVID infections, which have risen all summer.
sentences.zh: 这些批准出台之际，新冠感染人数仍在持续激增，整个夏天都在上升。

sentences.en: Remember to catch a new episode of The Interview right here tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 记得明天在这里收听《访谈》的新一期节目。

sentences.en: This week, Lulu Garcia Navarro talks with Jenna Ortega, the star of the Netflix series Wednesday and the new Beetlejuice sequel,
sentences.zh: 本周，露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗与Netflix剧集《星期三》及新《阴间大法师》续集的主演珍娜·奥尔特加进行了交谈，

sentences.en: about her head-spinning success over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 谈论了她过去几年里令人晕眩的成功。

sentences.en: One day, I just, I woke up in somebody else's shoes.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我只是，我醒来时发现自己穿上了别人的鞋子。

sentences.en: I felt like I had entered somebody else's life and, like, I didn't know how to get back to mine.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己进入了别人的生活，而且，我不知道该怎么回到我自己的生活。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Lindsay Garrison, Rob Zipko, Jessica Chung, Astha Chaturvedi, and Shannon Lynn.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由琳赛·加里森、罗布·齐普科、杰西卡·钟、阿斯哈·查图维迪和香农·林恩制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester.
sentences.zh: 由雷切尔·奎斯特编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Rowan Nemisto, Dan Powell, Diane Wong, and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含罗万·内米斯托、丹·鲍威尔、黛安·王和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐。
